summary: A classic 4-4-0 tender steam locomotive at standard gauge: a lathed boiler with brass bands, a smokebox with… joints drivers_front, rod_l, rod_r, drivers_rear, lead_axle_0, lead_axle_1, …; options livery, wheels, tender; sockets seat_driver, seat_crew_1, eye_point, socket_coupler_front, socket_coupler_rear, smoke, ….
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.steam_locomotive or place "prefab": "steam_locomotive" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d().
